entry.title: Market brief — 11 November 2026 close
entry.summary: Indian market brief in plain English: on Wednesday 11 November 2026 the Nifty 50 closed at 25,255.05 (+210.40, +0.84%) and the Sensex at 81,879.40 (+772.75, +0.95%), with the rupee 24 paise firmer at 93.69 per dollar. IBJA's benchmark put 24K gold at Rs 1,40,805 per 10 g (-1,615) and 999 silver at Rs 1,86,495 per kg (+495).
